python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Values in millions
value_2011 = 135030
value_2019 = 35810
n_years = 8  # From FY 2011 to FY 2019 (8 years)

# CAGR = (Ending/Beginning)^(1/n) - 1
cagr = (value_2019 / value_2011) ** (1 / n_years) - 1
print(f"CAGR: {cagr}")

# Annual decay factor = 1 + CAGR
annual_decay_factor = 1 + cagr
print(f"Annual decay factor: {annual_decay_factor}")

# Arc elasticity using midpoint percentage change
# Percentage change in X (value): (new - old) / old * 100
pct_change_value = (value_2019 - value_2011) / value_2011
print(f"Percentage change in value: {pct_change_value}")

# Percentage change in time: (new - old) / old * 100 = (2019-2011)/2011 = 8/2011
pct_change_time = n_years / 2011
print(f"Percentage change in time: {pct_change_time}")

# Arc elasticity = (% change in variable) / (% change in time)
# Using midpoint approach: (ΔY/Y) / (ΔX/X) with midpoint for both
# Midpoint percentage change method: (new - old) / ((new + old)/2)
midpoint_value = (value_2019 + value_2011) / 2
midpoint_pct_change_value = (value_2019 - value_2011) / midpoint_value
print(f"Midpoint percentage change in value: {midpoint_pct_change_value}")

midpoint_time = (2019 + 2011) / 2
midpoint_pct_change_time = (2019 - 2011) / midpoint_time
print(f"Midpoint percentage change in time: {midpoint_pct_change_time}")

arc_elasticity = midpoint_pct_change_value / midpoint_pct_change_time
print(f"Arc elasticity: {arc_elasticity}")

# Round to 3 decimal places
print(f"\nRounded to 3 decimal places:")
print(f"CAGR: {round(cagr, 3)}")
print(f"Annual decay factor: {round(annual_decay_factor, 3)}")
print(f"Arc elasticity: {round(arc_elasticity, 3)}")

# Output format
print(f"\nFinal answer: [{round(cagr, 3)}, {round(annual_decay_factor, 3)}, {round(arc_elasticity, 3)}]")
EOF
